key_path: dashboard.razorpay.com signup: email or 10-digit Indian phone + password
select business type, enter full name (basic details)
Account & Settings > API Keys > Generate Key (download key_id + key_secret; secret shown once)
live keys: complete KYC (CKYC instant since 2026-01-01 or Video KYC/doc upload) and website verification (up to 3 working days)

live: manual_approval (website review up to 3 working days)

agent_native_auth.oauth_dcr_for_mcp: yes - mcp.razorpay.com advertises registration_endpoint /register, PKCE S256; docs recommend DCR
agent_native_auth.provisioning_api_mints_keys: no for own account (Partner/Route Account APIs create sub-merchant accounts, beta)
agent_native_auth.scoped_restricted_keys: no - one key pair per mode, full access
agent_native_auth.test_mode_sandbox: yes - Test Mode keys without website or KYC
agent_native_auth.free_tier: yes - no setup fee; test mode free

mcp.type: product MCP (35+ tools: payments, orders, links, refunds, QR, settlements, payouts, checkout code generation)

remote.transport: streamable HTTP (docs also show npx mcp-remote bridge)
remote.auth: OAuth 2.0 with DCR, or base64(key_id:key_secret) merchant token in Authorization header

one_click: no Cursor/VS Code deeplinks found; manual mcp.json

docs_for_agents.llms_txt: https://razorpay.com/docs/llms.txt (~500 KB, includes 'Instructions for Large Language Model Agents' section)

score_justification: Strong MCP (remote OAuth-DCR + local) and LLM-specific docs tree, but test keys still need a human OTP signup and keys are all-or-nothing.
best_practice: A dedicated machine-readable docs tree (/docs/build/llm-docs/*.md) with an explicit instructions-for-agents block inside llms.txt.
biggest_gap: No CLI/device login or scoped keys; key secret is shown once and regenerating needs a mobile OTP, so an agent can't rotate or mint keys on its own.
